applicationStart:
cd code_deploy_application
pip install --no-user -r requirements.txt
flask translate compile
flask db upgrade
nohup gunicorn -b 0.0.0.0:8080 --access-logfile - --error-logfile - microblog:app >> /root/application.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /root/application.pid
applicationStop: if [ -f /root/application.pid ]; then kill "$(cat /root/application.pid)" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f /root/application.pid; fi
